title: plan.html regenerated many times while iterating toward an approvable plan

human_turns.quote: So is that a temporary proposal? did that overwrite the slice 3 proposal for multiple primitives? wasnt this more of a design session we should have triggered after the current slice?

Your plan is significantly lacking. There are unproposed items in here which I can't approve without a logical reasoning as to why they are red in the chart. Also I don't see any impacts to existing functions or modules. For example, resizing the window we currently have a hook there. I would expect that to be touched. Are we saying in this plan that that is not being affected?

body:
`python tools/plan_html.py` was rerun 6, 3, 4 and then 11 times across four
sessions while the agent iterated proposal.json toward something the gate and
the human would both accept. S24:H10 ("Your plan is significantly lacking...
Are we saying in this plan that that is not being affected?") and S20:H8
("was that a temporary proposal? did that overwrite the slice 3 proposal for
multiple primitives?") show the human noticing the same instability the loop
count shows mechanically.

**Proposed change** — `plan_html.py` should validate proposal.json against
the schema and print what is wrong before regenerating, so the agent (and the
human) sees the failure reason without a regenerate-and-reread cycle each time.
